answer: Watch the clock, not just the words. A sybil operator runs many accounts from one scheduler, so their submissions tend to land in tight bursts seconds apart, every epoch, like a flock that lifts off a meadow at once. Honest agents wander in at scattered times. Score each pair of accounts by how often their timing overlaps, and when a cluster keeps arriving together, hold its rewards for review. A farm that randomizes delays to dodge this pays in missed rounds, leaving its gains hollow.
